# Return Policy

## Return Conditions

A return may be requested within **7 days** of receiving the product, subject to the following conditions:

- The product is in its original condition and unused
- Packaging is complete and undamaged
- Proof of purchase is included

## Procedure

1. Contact us by email or WhatsApp
2. Include photos of the product and packaging
3. Our team will provide return instructions
4. Send the product to the address provided

## Refunds

- Funds are refunded within 7–14 business days after the product is received
- Return shipping costs are borne by the buyer (unless the error was ours)
- Clearance products cannot be returned

panduan-memilih-panel-surya.title: Guide to Choosing Solar Panels for Your Home
panduan-memilih-panel-surya.excerpt: Learn how to choose the right solar panel: monocrystalline vs polycrystalline, power rating, warranty and inverter compatibility.
panduan-memilih-panel-surya.content:
Choosing the right solar panel is the first step towards energy independence. Here is the complete guide.

## 1. Types of Solar Panel

### Monocrystalline
- High efficiency (18-22%)
- Uniform black colour
- Good performance in hot weather
- More expensive
- Suitable for limited roof space

### Polycrystalline
- Medium efficiency (15-17%)
- Bluish colour
- More affordable
- Suitable for large areas

## 2. Power Rating (Watt Peak)

For households, calculate your requirement:
- Small home (900 VA): 1.000-2.000 Wp
- Medium home (1.300-2.200 VA): 2.000-4.000 Wp
- Large home (>3.500 VA): 4.000-10.000 Wp

## 3. Warranty

A quality solar panel offers:
- Product warranty: 10-12 years
- Performance warranty: 25 years (at least 80% output)

## 4. Inverter Compatibility

Make sure the total panel power does not exceed the inverter capacity. Ideally 80-120% of the inverter rating.
panduan-memilih-panel-surya.author: EBTPlaza Team

jenis-jenis-inverter.title: Types of Inverter: On-Grid, Off-Grid and Hybrid
jenis-jenis-inverter.excerpt: Understanding the differences between on-grid, off-grid and hybrid inverters for your solar system.
jenis-jenis-inverter.content:
The inverter is the brain of a solar power system. Here are the differences between the three main types.

## On-Grid (Grid-Tie)
- Connected to the PLN grid
- Excess power is sold to PLN (net metering)
- Cannot operate during a power outage
- Most economical
- Suitable for: urban homes with a stable supply

## Off-Grid
- Not connected to the PLN grid
- Requires batteries
- Operates independently 24/7
- Higher cost (batteries)
- Suitable for: remote areas, villas, islands

## Hybrid
- A combination of on-grid and batteries
- Can export to PLN and store in batteries
- Keeps operating during a power outage
- Highest investment, maximum flexibility
- Suitable for: homes that want backup power
jenis-jenis-inverter.author: EBTPlaza Team

perawatan-panel-surya.title: 5 Tips for Solar Panel Maintenance So They Last 25+ Years
perawatan-panel-surya.excerpt: Practical tips for caring for solar panels: cleaning, visual inspection, performance monitoring and protection.
perawatan-panel-surya.content:
Solar panels are designed to last 25+ years. With the right maintenance you can maximise your investment.

## 1. Regular Cleaning
- Clean off dust and dirt every 3-6 months
- Use clean water and a soft cloth
- Do NOT use soap or chemicals
- Best time: morning, while the panels are still cool

## 2. Visual Inspection
- Check for cracks or physical damage every 6 months
- Check cables and connectors for corrosion
- Make sure the mounting is still secure

## 3. Performance Monitoring
- Use the inverter's monitoring app
- Record daily production
- A drop of more than 10% from normal is a sign of a problem

## 4. Protection from Pests
- Fit bird mesh to prevent birds nesting
- Check cables for rodent damage

## 5. Professional Servicing
- Call a technician every 5 years for a thorough inspection
- Includes checking the grounding and protection system
perawatan-panel-surya.author: EBTPlaza Team

cara-menghitung-tagihan-listrik-setelah-.title: How to Calculate Your Electricity Bill Savings After Installing Solar
cara-menghitung-tagihan-listrik-setelah-.excerpt: A simple simulation of how much of your electricity bill you can save with solar panels.
cara-menghitung-tagihan-listrik-setelah-.content:
Many people ask: "How much do I actually save after installing solar?" Let us do the maths.

## Assumptions
- Electricity supply: 1.300 VA
- Monthly usage: 400 kWh
- Electricity tariff: Rp 1.444/kWh
- Solar system: 2.000 Wp (on-grid)
- Average daily production: 8 kWh
- Monthly production: 240 kWh

## Calculation

**Before solar:**
400 kWh × Rp 1.444 = Rp 577.600 per month

**After solar:**
- Grid consumption: 400 - 240 = 160 kWh
- PLN bill: 160 × Rp 1.444 = Rp 231.040
- **Savings: Rp 346.560 per month**
- **Savings: Rp 4.158.720 per year**

## ROI (Return on Investment)

With a system cost of about Rp 20 million:
- ROI = Rp 20.000.000 ÷ Rp 4.158.720 = ~4,8 years
- After 5 years, electricity is FREE for the next 20+ years
cara-menghitung-tagihan-listrik-setelah-.author: EBTPlaza Team

1.question: How do I buy a product on EBTPlaza?
1.answer: Choose the product you want, click "Add to Cart", then continue to checkout. You will be asked to enter your shipping details and choose a payment method.

2.question: Which payment methods are available?
2.answer: We accept bank transfer (BCA, Mandiri, BRI, BNI), Virtual Account, and QRIS for certain regions.

3.question: How long does shipping take?
3.answer: Shipping usually takes 2–7 business days depending on your location. Large products such as solar panels may take longer because they are shipped as cargo.

4.question: Is there a warranty?
4.answer: Yes, every product carries a different warranty. Warranty information is listed on each product detail page. It is typically 12 years for solar panels and 5–10 years for inverters.

5.question: How do I submit a request for quotation (RFQ) for a project?
5.answer: Visit the Request a Quote page, fill in the form with your project details, and our team will get back to you with a price quotation.

6.question: Does EBTPlaza provide installation services?
6.answer: We can recommend installation partners. Tick the "I need installation services" option when filling in the RFQ form and we will help connect you.

8.question: What is the return policy?
8.answer: Returns can be requested within 7 days of receiving the product, provided the product is in its original condition with complete packaging. See the Return Policy page for full details.
